description: Pans one input across eight outputs placed at the corners of a virtual cube, using three independent panners

params.text: Sets that dimension's ratio from 0% to 100%, 50% at noon; X is measured as percent right, Y as percent top and Z as percent back
Attenuverts that dimension's CV input, -100% to 100%; at full the CV moves the dimension by 10% per volt
Attenuates all eight outputs by the same amount, 0% to 100%
Sums the polyphonic channels of every output down to one monophonic signal

inputs.text: Bipolar CV for that dimension, summed with the panner knob through the attenuverter and clamped between 0% and 100%
The signal panned across the eight outputs

outputs.text: Carries the share of the input panned to that corner of the cube; hover over it to read whether it is left or right, bottom or top, front or back

menu: CV amount scale — -100% to 100% by default, or -200% to 200%, which lets a bipolar 5V sine or triangle reach one extreme and hold there before travelling to the other
